t: A starter board with LEDs, buttons, and a buzzer that a Raspberry Pi Pico plugs into.
steps: Find the Maker Pi Pico board at Cytron or a retailer.
Decide whether to buy a bare board or one with a Pico soldered on.
Plug a Pico into the board.
Connect the board to a computer by USB.
Load a MicroPython or C and C++ program.
Try the example code on the Cytron GitHub.
Test one board before buying a class set.
